clauses: Create an XLSX spreadsheet workbook at canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/VERIFIED_CAPABILITIES.xlsx containing exactly one row for every VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY with columns capability_id, status, source_type, provides, and incremental_spend_usd

Finally independently reopen the workbook and verify that every VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY from the registry appears exactly once, that no non-verified capability appears, and that every row's values match the canonical registry
